purpose: Reusable UI/state/workflow comparison plan. Cases are not execution results.

baseline.deployedIdentity: Separate from integratedSourceHead; current delivery state says PR251 is not deployed.

comparisonRules.compare: Insignia app content only, at equal CSS width inside the merchant app iframe or customer Designer frame.
comparisonRules.data: Match real product/order complexity, visible labels, locale, theme, image availability, and starting workflow state.
comparisonRules.authority: Demo estimate, fake upload, local receipt, screenshot, HTTP success, or click is not production authority or persistence proof.
comparisonRules.customerHost: Shopify owns product page, cart, checkout, theme editor, and language settings.
forbiddenComparisons: Retired MerchantConfigEditor against the selected production editor.
Developer-only StorefrontHostPreview against the Shopify customer product/cart UI.
One-view/default-variant fixture against a richer product as proof of a missing conditional control.
Local preview price estimate against a production quote as if both were authoritative.
comparisonRules.nativeWriteBoundary: Native writes use an explicitly owned DEV QA lane and fresh readback. No checkout, payment, email, theme, scope or unallocated source-store effects. The separately authorized source LPO Draft change is completed and documented in lpo-product-visibility.md.

executionLayers.preview-demo: Loopback frontend demo with explicit synthetic fixtures/adapters. May mutate only its own memory/session/local fixture.
executionLayers.built-local: Built production route or selected package with controlled API/Shopify host doubles. Verifies UI and adapter boundary, not provider durability or native Shopify behavior.
executionLayers.native-read-only: Actual Shopify host/data observations without business mutation.
executionLayers.native-owned-write: Actual user-authorized development QA products/resources with exclusive lane ownership, mutation identity and fresh readback. Screenshots alone do not establish persistence. Completed source-store exceptions are documented separately.
executionLayers.source-probe: Source/reducer/helper state evidence only; does not pass a rendered user interaction.

merchantDemo.normalEntry: Loopback URL printed by preview.mts; default scenario order-demo opens a synthetic purchase detail. Set INSIGNIA_PREVIEW_SCENARIO=normal for Products with the simple synthetic config, or orders-rich for Orders.
merchantDemo.notes: Uses a built SSR renderer, synthetic APIs, fake local host/Bridge/Polaris and separate in-memory order demo. Preview state normal with scenario order-demo substitutes local Home, product editor and Methods adapters. No provider writes.

merchantIntegrated.notes: Compare inner app document only. Production routes compose selected islands with authenticated containers.

customerDemo.notes: Local runtime, estimates, storage, saved designs, upload and add/update results are examples only.

customerIntegrated.host: Actual Shopify product page and theme trigger
customerIntegrated.notes: Reconfirm current deployed source/artifact and product facts before native review. Compare Designer frame only.

merchantCustomerPreview.launch: Selected product editor Preview action opens a nonce-bound unsaved snapshot.
merchantCustomerPreview.authority: Temporary local object URLs; preview-only ports; cart commit rejects.

postOrderCustomerArtwork.authority: Scoped capability, missing-artwork-only attach and real artwork upload service; never a cart mutation.
postOrderCustomerArtwork.nativeEntry: Requires an already issued valid test capability. Do not trigger email.

surfaces.owner: MerchantHomeContainer and selected MerchantHome; Home source, guidance and action reducers.

cases.title: Loading-to-ready panels and aggregate facts
cases.setup: Use a store with products, recent orders, known whole-store aggregate and explicit theme/billing readiness.
walkthrough: Open the linked Products and Orders routes.
assert: Each panel moves independently to its observed result.
Metrics equal authenticated aggregate facts; unavailable is not rendered as zero.
Recent-order links identify the selected purchase.
No sample/demo totals leak into integrated composition.

cases.title: First-use, empty and unknown catalog guidance
cases.setup: Exercise complete empty catalog, current page with continuation and known published product on a later page.
walkthrough: Open Home with no product records.
Open Home with a partial first catalog page.
Repeat with a published configured product only beyond the first page.
assert: Complete absence can show first-use guidance.
Incomplete catalog remains unknown and does not claim absence.
Store-wide test guidance appears when later-page evidence establishes a published product.
cases.knownFinding: F6: homeHasPublishedProduct currently collapses a partial page to false; source helper probe recorded in the whole-product audit.

cases.title: Independent panel failure, retry and focus
cases.setup: Fail only Products, only Orders, then both; separately return session/access unavailable.
walkthrough: Fail it while another panel succeeds.
Navigate away during a held read and return.
assert: Failure remains scoped to its panel where supported.
Retry reports busy and recovers without replacing successful content.
Session loss shows unavailable/reopen recovery.
Late old response cannot replace current observation.
Retry and navigation do not invent totals.

cases.title: Persisted guidance and theme setup tasks
cases.setup: Use active embed, missing theme button/cart review, incomplete or unknown eligibility, dismissed checklist and a denied preference read.
walkthrough: Open the Shopify-owned handoff without saving theme changes.
assert: Guidance reflects stored shop-wide preference only after authoritative preference read.
Unknown eligibility remains actionable/retryable.
Handoff opens Shopify; demo handoff is labelled and cannot alter theme.
Checklist completion is not presented as verified theme activation.
cases.writeBoundary: Local synthetic preference only; native is read-only.

cases.title: Search, filters, paging and request ownership
cases.setup: Use more than one catalog page with distinct configured/draft/published/unconfigured records.
walkthrough: Issue a slower prior query, then a faster current query.
assert: Filtering/search covers the server dataset.
Page and filter changes clear page selection.
Stale request cannot replace current page.
Rows route to the exact product configuration.

cases.title: Empty, no-match, per-page-empty, failed and denied states
cases.setup: Use a truly empty catalog, an empty search result, a page with no visible records, 503 then success, and 403.
assert: No products, no search match and empty page are distinguishable.
403 does not appear as transient success.
Retry restores the actual catalog.
No demo product appears in integrated failure recovery.

cases.title: Selection summary, CSV/export and selection reset
cases.setup: Select one then multiple visible products, including a filter/page transition.
walkthrough: Select rows and all visible rows.
Change page/filter and open the bulk action.
assert: Selection count matches visible selection.
Selection clears on query/page change.
Export content reflects exact current records.
Summary download failure is recoverable and does not claim a save.

cases.title: Preview and setup-copy action routing
cases.setup: Use one product with a published preview and two independent empty target products.
walkthrough: Cancel, then separately confirm in a local browser fixture.
assert: Preview is the non-purchasing unsaved preview route.
Cancel creates no copy.
Copy receives fresh product-owned identities and retained production labels/options.
A local copy result is never reported as native persistence.
cases.writeBoundary: Demo is local-only; integrated save requires a separately owned QA product.

surfaces.owner: SelectedProductContainer, SelectedProductEditor, selected-product-client, placement-workflow-state.mts, scoped media and publication adapters.

cases.title: Open, initial read, read-only and unavailable recovery

walkthrough: Navigate away while a read is held.
assert: Selected editor receives current product/config/media/Method data.

cases.title: Add views picker dismissal without commit

assert: All three paths close picker, restore focus and preserve draft counts.
No save/create/publish request is sent.

cases.title: Choose and add a view with exact image mapping
cases.setup: Use a product with multiple real images and an empty or partially configured view set.
walkthrough: Reload after the owned local fixture save.
assert: Only the confirmed image/view is added.
Cancel leaves the draft and Save Bar unchanged.
Exact image identity survives save/reload.
No front/back/color mapping is inferred from file name.

cases.title: Rename, reorder and remove view/placement
cases.setup: Use at least two views and two placements, including one selected placement with configuration.
walkthrough: Confirm removal in a controlled fixture.
assert: IDs and artwork mappings follow intended view identity.
Cancel has no write.
Confirm removes only the exact target and invalidates incompatible selection modes.
Undo/redo restores the exact authoring snapshot where offered.
cases.writeBoundary: Native save requires owned QA product.

cases.title: Draw placement, measurement and calibrated size preview
cases.setup: Use real product image dimensions, a calibrated view and supported placement geometry.
assert: Normalized coordinates remain within image and preserve exact typed values.
Invalid measurement shows recoverable validation.
Customer preview geometry matches saved selected geometry.
No unsourced manufacturing precision is implied.
cases.writeBoundary: Local fixture only until owned QA product.

cases.title: Movement area editing and boundary recovery
cases.setup: Use a product whose published setup allows customer movement, plus a fixed-position product.
assert: Valid area contains full artwork footprint.
Invalid movement shows reason and retains previous valid geometry.
Changing target cancels only incompatible interaction.
Fixed-position product exposes no movement controls.

cases.title: Method binding, inheritance, override, blank and explicit zero
cases.setup: Use at least two Methods, one inherited default, one product override, one unset cell and one explicit zero.
walkthrough: Enter explicit zero in a supported cell.
assert: Equal values retain explicit provenance when deliberately edited.
Blank/unset is not rendered as free.
Zero is exact only where selected.
Method import changes only the unsaved product until saved.
Shop currency change requires explicit review.
cases.writeBoundary: Local fixture or owned QA product.

cases.title: Variant photo matrix, sparse options and alignment review
cases.setup: Use actual Shopify product options/variant IDs, 64-variant T-shirt photo coverage, and local incomplete/ambiguous/long-name examples.
assert: Every saved assignment maps to an actual variant tuple and exact photo.
Sparse/unavailable tuples remain unavailable.
Missing/retired/ambiguous options require review and are not silently dropped.
Product and view alignment overrides survive reload.
cases.writeBoundary: Native read-only; assignments saved only in owned QA product.

cases.title: Dirty state, native Save Bar, save success and fresh reload
cases.setup: Use an isolated product draft with a single small valid authored change.
walkthrough: Reload route and fresh-read the same product.
assert: Dirty and saved values are visually distinct.
Save sends one versioned command with frozen scope.
Fresh read matches exact method/view/placement/option/price identities.
Publish state is not implied by Save.
cases.writeBoundary: Native save only on separately owned QA product.

cases.title: Denied, conflict, uncertain save and exact retry identity
cases.setup: Control held response, 403, stale CAS version, malformed/lost reply after commit and session-storage denial.
walkthrough: Reopen/reload and explicitly retry or reload the winning version.
assert: Access loss clears private state and fences late completion.
Conflict preserves dirty local edits until explicit reload.
Uncertain result keeps original command custody and exact retry identity.
No false saved success or duplicate write.

cases.title: Publish readiness, pending, provider failure and exact active revision
cases.setup: Use incomplete draft, then a complete owned QA draft; control pending, failed, conflict and correlated active readback.
walkthrough: Read back the exact active revision.
assert: Incomplete draft is savable if allowed but sends no publish.
Pending/failed/conflict remain distinct.
Publication success identifies exact activated revision/source.
Older active revision cannot settle a newer attempt.
cases.writeBoundary: No native publish in this plan.

cases.title: Dirty leave, cancel and confirmed discard
cases.setup: Make one edit, begin leave/route navigation and hold destination load.
walkthrough: Request leave again and confirm discard.
assert: Cancel returns to the same usable draft.
Confirm discard restores last saved snapshot without a write.
Host navigation is not left under a stale skeleton.
Dialog state resumes when an embedded subdialog was active.

cases.title: Media upload, rejection, expiry and permission revocation
cases.setup: Use supported image, unsupported/oversized image, delayed upload, expired private image, denied media read.
walkthrough: Cancel or switch target while pending.
Expire image/access while preview is open.
assert: Only verified response applies to current target.
Failure provides retry/removal reason.
Late blob body cannot restore revoked private data.
Object URLs and temporary content are retired on dispose.

cases.title: Independent setup copy and retained choices
cases.setup: Copy from a configured product with retained production definitions, Method translations and image alignment into an empty target.
walkthrough: Reload the target and compare identities/labels.
assert: Cancel sends no command.
Copy creates new product-owned identities.
Definitions/labels survive but source mutable data is not shared.
Copy requires the documented review before publication.
cases.writeBoundary: Synthetic fixture only; native copy needs an owned QA product.

cases.title: Merchant customer preview is unsaved and non-purchasing
cases.setup: Use a saved product snapshot and unsaved preview snapshot, with a viewBox-only SVG upload.
assert: Preview displays the intended unsaved snapshot.
Preview-only upload is temporary.
No production artwork/save/publish/cart request occurs.
Closing revokes preview resources.

surfaces.demoEntry: merchantDemo /admin/methods; original or large generated catalog.

walkthrough: Navigate away during catalog read and during paginated product reads.
assert: No fake method appears in integrated recovery.

Existing dispatched write keeps its journal custody.

cases.title: Create/edit validation and saved reload

cases.title: Unset, explicit zero, fixed/product pricing and currency review

assert: Zero and unset remain distinct.

Explicit equal-value review creates the documented versioned change.

cases.title: Manual/product/collection/tag assignment selection

assert: Cancel leaves staged assignment unchanged.

Tag matching follows contract.

cases.title: Duplicate and delete confirmation lifecycle

walkthrough: Open delete confirmation and cancel, then delete in local fixture.
assert: Cancel sends no write.
Duplicate uses fresh ID and exact source values.
Delete removes only selected Method and version.
X/Escape/Cancel close without stale host scrim.

cases.title: Dirty navigation resumes staged dialog or confirms leave

walkthrough: Verify original subdialog and staged selections.
assert: Cancel resumes exact staged state.
Confirm follows intended target.

cases.title: Lost reply, idempotent replay, session loss and responsive list

walkthrough: Revoke access during another pending write.
assert: Original operation key is resumed, not duplicated.
Authorization loss scrubs private editor state.
Readonly actor cannot mutate through host callbacks.

No quote/cart request starts for ineligible design.

cases.title: Quote preparation remains cancellable and exact review is authoritative
cases.setup: Use actual shop currency and configured prices; hold quote preparation, edit quantities and compare with local estimate.
walkthrough: Change intent and return stale quote.
assert: Review preparation is not cart-submit pending; selected controls remain usable.
Only matching current intent quote is shown.
Production amount/currency/minor-unit strings are server authoritative.
Local estimate is clearly a demo and cannot enable purchase.

cases.title: Quote expiration, decline and explicit repair
cases.setup: Return expired proposal, known expiry, REVIEW_REQUIRED/unavailable retained lookup, current cart drift and configuration change.
walkthrough: Open explicit repair and review current cart.
assert: A declined/resolved command is distinct from lost acknowledgement.
No new proposal/key is allocated until original identity is reconciled.
Unavailable retained lookup does not silently clear ownership.
Current cart drift is checked before acceptance.
cases.knownFinding: Q1 from selected-state audit: repeated acceptance/prepare path needs explicit decline-vs-unknown recovery classification.
cases.writeBoundary: Local controlled API only; no native cart action.

cases.title: Cart add/update receipt, failure and navigation
cases.setup: Use one isolated matching cart intent; control applied, malformed, failed, delayed and unknown receipt.
walkthrough: Read cart independently before any retry.
assert: Only matching verified Shopify request/receipt closes and navigates to locale-native /cart.
Failed/unknown stays on product page with design intact.
No duplicate submit during pending.
Retry preserves original idempotency identity after reconciliation.
cases.knownFinding: F3: one prior native add attempt failed and independent readback showed an empty cart. Do not replay until that attempt's evidence is reconciled.
cases.writeBoundary: Native cart mutation requires separate authorized, isolated QA lane; no checkout.

cases.title: Close/reopen, same design, new design and dirty design switch
cases.setup: Use unsaved draft, accepted cart design, same design reopen and a second owned cart design.
assert: Ordinary close retains draft without discard prompt.
Same unchanged design resumes.
Only actual dirty different-design switch confirms.
Quote review requirement alone is not dirty.
Start new resets intended content but preserves approved artwork library semantics.

cases.title: Retained production options and cart edit restore
cases.setup: Use a product carrying immutable production-choice definitions/labels and saved cart design with accepted values.
assert: Definitions, labels and accepted values survive mapping/restoration.
Unchanged choices are not dirty; changed choice creates a distinct attempt.
A failed/unavailable choice never becomes a default/free option.
Unknown or retired choice needs explicit removal/review.

cases.title: Preview media expiry, renewal and terminal unavailability
cases.setup: Expire signed preview for same publication, then change publication and expire accepted asset.
assert: Renewal can replace media only from same published revision.
Terminal loss does not revive artwork or discard production choices.
No stale URL or changed price is trusted.
Recovery remains explicit.

cases.title: Theme, customer language, dark/light and narrow viewport
cases.setup: Use theme preference absent/explicit, valid store locale, browser fallback, wording overlay, 390 and 320 CSS px.
walkthrough: Change language while invalid input/upload/quote is pending.
assert: Language/theme changes preserve design, validation and focus.
Host locale wins when valid; browser fallback only without host context.
No horizontal overflow or clipped essential control at sampled widths.
Shopify-owned language/theme controls are excluded from comparison.

cases.title: Native section, variant, quick-add and Firefox lifecycle
cases.setup: Open actual product in Chromium and Firefox; vary section reload, variant, quick-add and theme-editor lifecycle.
assert: Frame only owns current product/session.
Transient eligibility failure is retryable without polling or replacing ordinary purchase controls.
No stale dialog/scroll lock/focus leak.
Firefox parent/source/origin/channel checks work without referrer.

cases.title: Nonce-bound unsaved customer preview with temporary artwork
cases.setup: Use current product snapshot, nonce and valid same-origin opener; separately test wrong origin/nonce and invalid product snapshot.
assert: Only current opener/origin/nonce is accepted once.
Preview error has actionable bounded reason.
Upload stays object-URL local.
No production upload/save/publish/cart request and object URLs are revoked.

surfaces.demoEntry: No customer capability portal equivalent in the isolated UI demo.
surfaces.owner: mountCustomerArtwork, secure post-order API, real artwork uploader and fill-missing-only server contract.

cases.title: Capability rejection, loading, retry and completed state
cases.setup: Use malformed/missing capability, valid test capability, failed read, expired capability, no configuration and zero missing slots.
walkthrough: Close completed portal and refresh view.
assert: Capability fragment is scrubbed from location before later navigation.
Missing/expired capability reveals no purchase data.
No-missing-slot state is clearly complete.
Load failure is retryable and locale-aware.
cases.writeBoundary: Read-only except later attach case; no email dispatch.

cases.title: Fill one originally missing slot with verified artwork
cases.setup: Use valid scoped capability, exact purchase/version and one or more missing artwork slots.
walkthrough: Reload portal to show next remaining slot.
assert: Attachment targets only currently missing slot.
Fresh version/slot read is checked at commit.
Completion is idempotent and reopens on next remaining group.
No cart, price, quantity or existing artwork changes.
cases.writeBoundary: Synthetic in local test; native upload only with a separately supplied already-valid test capability.

cases.title: Concurrent fill, stale slot and ambiguous attachment retry
cases.setup: Two tabs target same missing slot; make one attach succeed while the other's initial read is stale; separately lose acknowledgement after command.
walkthrough: Reconcile ambiguous first result using same request identity.
assert: Only first valid attach commits.
Second sees slot already filled and cannot replace it.
Unknown acknowledgement retries exact same attach identity only.
Neither path can alter cart or paid economics.

knownFindings.summary: Native Add views X/Escape did not close; Cancel did close. Shared modal lifecycle requires host-aware replay.
Intermittent native Methods/product editor read failure; cause unconfirmed.
One native Add to cart attempt failed and was read back as empty. Reconcile original attempt before any new mutation.
Shopify selection was not carried into a fresh Designer; ownership is a UX decision.
Translations host/language/startup group labels fall back to Unavailable.
Home page-only published product helper can omit test invitation when a qualifying product is on a later page.
Intentional SVG policy rejection has limited actionable recovery copy.
Flattened production package externals were not qualified in a clean relocated Linux package.
Declined quote/review recovery must distinguish resolved rejection from unknown acknowledgement before allocating another proposal/key.
